content:
Last month, there were reports that Apple is developing a new AI-powered shopping assistant for the Apple Store app on iPhone and iPad.

It now appears that Apple is rolling out this feature to some users in the form of an "Early Preview".

In the Apple Store app, some users will now see a new chat-style icon in the bottom-right corner, replacing the traditional search icon. On that page, users can search for products or start a conversation with a "virtual shopping assistant".

Suggested prompts include:

  • The latest Apple products
  • Help me check the trade-in value
  • Explain carrier deals
  • Help me choose a Watch
  • iPhone monthly instalment plans
  • Compare the iPad product line

The image above is a preview of this new design, courtesy of ShrimpApplePro on X.

Apple's fine print also explains:

Not everyone will have access to the shopping assistant in the Apple Store app. Apple says that only select users can try it out through "Early Preview" for now, and there is no word yet on when it will be rolled out fully.

What do you think of Apple adding this new AI assistant to the Apple Store app? Would you use it? Feel free to let us know in the comments below.
